nodes.description: No FDA-approved disease-modifying therapy exists; multidisciplinary management across biochemical genetics, neurology, cardiology, orthopedics, nutrition, and rehabilitation is supportive. Recommended surveillance includes yearly neurologic, physiotherapy, nutritional, seizure-risk, cervical spine stability, and hip dislocation assessments, plus electrocardiogram, echocardiogram, and eye examination every 1 to 3 years. Agents and circumstances to avoid include unplanned anesthesia management (given skeletal and airway risks), psychotropic medications (risk of worsening neurologic disease), aspiration-prone feeding positions, seizure medication dosages that cause excessive sedation, and fall-risk situations.
